subject: the approved WAHALA! soundtrack (Lagos No Dey Sleep package + seven district songs): files whose track ids start with lnds_ or dist_ in music/manifest.json, and the lnds_victory / lnds_defeat stingers
meaning: Released on the founder's documented, risk-aware decision. This is NOT a legal clearance, NOT a licence from Google and NOT a lawyer's opinion; none exists. Google's official terms were reviewed on 2026-11-25 and no explicit prohibition of commercial use of Gemini-app music was found, but no grant, warranty or indemnity was found either (docs/AUDIO_RIGHTS_ASSESSMENT.md).
authorisation: Written instruction from the founder in the release assignment 'Approved Soundtrack Release, Junction Blast Rename and Final Menu UX' (2026-11-25): proceed with a documented, risk-aware release of the approved soundtrack; do not fabricate permission or a legal opinion.

scope.note: SHA-256 of tools/audio/release/SHA256SUMS. A different set of shipped files is outside this authorisation: a new decision (and a new digest) is needed.

acknowledgedRisks: R1 No grant: no official Google page says the user owns Gemini-app music or licenses it for commercial use; Google only says it will not claim ownership.
R2 No exclusivity or copyright assurance: purely AI-generated material may have no copyright, and similar output may be produced for others.
R3 No non-infringement warranty or indemnity for consumer-app output; Lyria and the Gemini app are not on Google's indemnified-services list. A third-party claim would fall on the studio.
R4 'Business user' ambiguity: a studio shipping a game may count as a business user under the Terms; how that applies to a consumer-app account is unconfirmed.
R5 Editing, mastering, looping, stem separation and mixing are not addressed by any official page.

R6 SynthID: the watermark survives MP3 compression; detectors will flag the files. No page requires labelling the music as AI-made, but misleading people about human authorship is barred. Store and regional AI-disclosure rules are unreviewed.
R7 No similarity check against existing songs, lyrics or titles was done; vocals or likeness questions are open.
R8 Terms can change; whether new terms reach earlier output is not stated.
evidence: Official-source review dated 2026-11-25 (docs/AUDIO_RIGHTS_ASSESSMENT.md, sections 2-3); provenance and generation history (docs/AUDIO_PROVENANCE.md, tools/audio/release/provenance.json); the founder's private provenance record (conversation address, account, prompts, generation dates) is kept by the founder and referenced here only by the SHA-256 in docs/AUDIO_PROVENANCE.md.
withdraw: On a rights complaint, a Terms change that prohibits this use, or a founder decision: set status to "not-cleared" (the next publish is then refused) and remove or replace the lnds_ / dist_ tracks; the Pixabay fallbacks stay.
